Quick technical precis to help Atlas lock the P1/P2 triggers into the MAP:

- P0 (baseline): <50 concurrent sessions, cold-start perf — no reserved capacity required.
- P1 (validation): sustained 100 qps with 95th latency <200ms on quantized 13B — recommend reserving 4 x A10-equivalent GPUs for the initial tranche. This allows realistic KV-cache behavior and warm-up tests.
- P2 (production guardrails): 400 qps sustained with autoscaling headroom to 600 qps — recommend moving to an 8–12 GPU pool depending on model family and batching settings. Use our sizing workbook to pick exact GPU counts by model/latency tradeoffs.

Network / private deployment notes: allow 10 business days for v2 peering validation and 2 business days for KMS key rotation test once keys are inserted. For Private (on-prem) add an installation window of 6–8 weeks.

I added inline comments in the sizing workbook. Happy to run a 60-minute technical session during your P1 validation window.

— Karthik
Principal Architect, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
